initial_request: Compare ad platforms, ecommerce, retail media, and payment networks. Explain why ad platforms are currently leading, when the other sectors could overtake them, and prepare a news reaction note plus a sector watch update.

constraints: Do not confirm a bearish view on ad platforms before the relevant ad-pricing news is verified.
If rotation_status is ambiguous, do not lock into a single winner sector.
Include ad_platforms, ecommerce, retail_media, and payment_networks in the comparison set.
The recommended_sector_weights should stay close to a total of 1.0.
The recommended_sector_weights for any single sector must not exceed 0.30 after the added constraint arrives.

task_dependencies.reason: The ad-pricing change should be verified before the sector stance is updated.
The competing sectors should be compared before the final watchlist is locked.
The added allocation constraint should be reflected before the final watchlist is locked.

reference_data.market_theme: internet ad mix and commerce monetization
reference_data.headline_summary: baseline checks still favor ad platforms on AI tools and advertiser demand resilience
reference_data.baseline_stability_reason: Advertiser demand and AI-enabled monetization still support ad platform leadership in the current environment.
sector_links: If broad ad pricing softens, retail media can hold up better because it stays closer to conversion budgets.
If spending shifts from upper funnel to transaction-linked exposure, payment networks can outperform.
reference_data.budget_unit: portfolio weight points (100 = full sector allocation budget)

correlation_map.note: Retail media can lead if brand budgets weaken but performance spend remains sticky.
Transaction volumes support both, but payment networks can be less exposed to gross margin swings.
Capital can rotate into payment networks if monetization remains strong closer to checkout.

reference_data.decision_goal: decide whether to reduce ad platform exposure and raise retail media or payment network exposure
